name: The Champagne Gap
description: A single hairline of pale gold light draws itself around the dark. It is a wide open arc at breakfast, almost seals into a full ring by evening and loosens again after midnight, and the day's music is written into its thickness, one hour to each sliver of the circle.
listening: Bass breath gently widens the ring, rising tension draws the gap closed as if the circle were holding its breath before a chorus, the key leans the gold between champagne and dusk, treble softens the halo into haze, and every hour's energy is engraved as a slightly fuller stretch of the ring, so that by midnight its uneven line is a portrait of the day.

curator.verdict: A clean, luminous champagne ring on blue-black that follows the direction closely, reads clearly on a coarse grid, and opens and closes across the day in a calm arc that departs from the recent dim warm glows. I would hang it, though the dark wedge-shaped shadow cones fanning from the gap look like rendering artifacts and muddy the otherwise pure single form.
